This post will explain how you can navigate these challenges and establish a fully functional digital storefront using sovereign commerce stacks.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online traditionally involves relying on platforms that charge high fees and impose strict regulations. For instance, Gumroad takes 10% on every sale, which can significantly cut into your profits. By leveraging a sovereign commerce stack, you can accept Bitcoin directly, minimizing fees to just 0.5% with NOWPayments. This allows you to retain more of your earnings, making it a crucial strategy for digital creators who need to maximize their revenue without the burden of platform restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack is designed to provide complete ownership and control over your sales process. It utilizes free tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. This integration ensures that product delivery is automated, allowing for instant access to music purchases without intermediate platforms. You maintain full data ownership, which is essential for long-term scalability and independence.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This framework is specifically tailored for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or present significant barriers. If you’re a music producer, educator, or template designer in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, or Venezuela, this solution empowers you to sell directly to your audience. By using a sovereign commerce stack, you can create a reliable revenue stream without being dependent on third-party platforms that may restrict your operations.
Retain more profits by minimizing transaction fees to just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of a sovereign commerce stack include a hosting solution like Cloudflare Pages, a backend service like Supabase for order management, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Each element is designed to work in harmony, ensuring that the entire process from product listing to payment confirmation is seamless. The automation of file delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script also enhances the customer experience, ensuring that buyers receive their music instantly upon purchase.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your music online, first choose a stack that fits your needs. Consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all six blueprints and seven templates needed to establish your store. Next, set up your hosting with GitHub Pages and configure your backend with Supabase. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, and finally, upload your music files for automated delivery. This straightforward process allows you to launch your digital storefront efficiently and effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign commerce stack that integrates cryptocurrency payments. This approach minimizes fees significantly, allowing you to keep more of your earnings. By leveraging free tools and services, you can create a fully functional store that operates independently of traditional payment platforms.
Automate your product delivery with seamless integration of backend tools.

If you're searching for ways to sell your digital products without conventional platforms, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This comprehensive package provides everything you need to build and deploy your own digital store using sovereign payment solutions. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for instant access.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

NOWPayments charges a competitive fee of just 0.5% on each transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This allows you to maximize your revenue while accepting cryptocurrency payments.
